tool_args.rationale: The pilot shows positive short-horizon gain, while the paid slow-horizon observations establish a reversal by H=14.9 and constrain the target horizon. Numerically fit the authorized four-parameter dual-exponential law and submit it for fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The acquired probe already supplies three long-horizon observations, including the target horizon, alongside five pilot observations for the four-parameter law.
All observed s_grad values are zero, so its sink parameter cannot be identified from these observations; the authorized four-parameter mechanism directly explains the observed reversal.
The observed short-to-long horizon behavior and authorized adaptation note favor the dual-exponential mechanism.
